body: After a mugshot of rapper SkiMaskTheSlumpGod surfaced online yesterday, the Florida rapper has addressed the situation and offered some context surrounding what happened. According to Ski Mask, he has already been home for some time and says the situation was not as serious as it may have appeared online. He explained that he got out to check on the individual involved in the incident to make sure they were okay and nobody was hurt.

source_caption_text:
After a mugshot of rapper #SkiMaskTheSlumpGod surfaced online yesterday, the Florida rapper has addressed the situation and offered some context surrounding what happened.

According to Ski Mask, he has already been home for some time and says the situation was not as serious as it may have appeared online. He explained that he got out to check on the individual involved in the incident to make sure they were okay and nobody was hurt.

“I’ve been home for a while — it wasn’t that serious of a situation as it seems, and I got out to check on the person to make sure they were okay and nobody was hurt, that sh*t was at 4 in the morning.” ❤️‍🩹

Ski Mask’s statement appears aimed at providing his side of the story and reassuring supporters that he is good.
